summary: A candidate who falls short after a challenge says they should have checked the pages, blames the paid circulators, and accepts the county's count.
realLife: A mayoral candidate left the ballot after a signature review left him short; he said he should have verified the signatures before filing, denied any forgery, and blamed the firm that hired the circulators.
sources: Yahoo News, mayoral candidate withdraws after signatures disqualified, April 2024: https://www.yahoo.com/news/glendale-mayoral-candidate-jamie-aldama-232803412.html
inGame: petition-short; paid circulator vendor; the clerk's count

turns.turn: He owns the lapse and says nothing against the count
He points at the rival who filed the challenge
turns.writesBack: a charge the rival's side calls a distraction
